self_contained_arguments: Phi1 directly forces rational X,u: even a has rational u; odd a uses invariance of uderivative/u against the quadratic sign involution. The general pure-phase rationality theorem is unnecessary for the fixed-field DZ iff.
Phi=1 forces J=1; nontrivial u has finite nonzero infinity value and u'/u=1/(xP).
Squarefree P and exact integral residues determine H, zeros/poles and the full marked DZ-pair inverse over K.
Exact degree (a+2)(r+1), height-zero rigidity, every-r classical star realization and full unsafe spectra.
A monic equation over the infinity DVR proves every nontrivial Phi=1 phase has the SAME x/Z marker surviving infinitely many even orders.
Finite passport range r<=N<=1+a(r-1); finite saturated equations over Q transfer the complex classification to every algebraically closed characteristic-zero field.
Ordered weighted-tree decomposition T=(1+zT)^a and a formal-residue proof give the exact Fuss-Catalan count (1/r)binom(ar,r-1).
Explicit eta^2=-2 marked-unitree example proves the geometric count cannot be read as a count over Q or R.
